email.subject: Lost item on a route 20 bus, Friday, October 9
email.body:
Hello,

I hope you are doing well. I need to report a missing belonging. I accidentally left [[ITEM]] on a route 20 bus, moving toward Five Points Station. I got off at Piedmont Ave SE @ Gilmer St SE on Friday, October 9, at about 1:17 PM.

I also submitted these details via the web form. If it is found, please let me know how I can pick it up. I am happy to provide a full description and show my photo ID.

Thank you.
